FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.description: Everything you need to know about our services, technologies, and development process.
FAQ.footer: Still have questions? Feel free to contact us and we’ll gladly help you with your project.

f1.a: We specialize in modern web development, mobile applications, cloud infrastructure, UI/UX design, and scalable digital solutions tailored for businesses and startups.

f2.a: Our primary stack includes Next.js, React, TypeScript, TailwindCSS, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Docker, and modern cloud deployment platforms like Vercel.

f3.q: Do you work with international clients?
f3.a: Yes. We work remotely with clients worldwide and communicate in both English and Spanish depending on the project requirements.

f4.q: How long does a project usually take?
f4.a: Project timelines depend on complexity and scope. Small business websites may take a few weeks, while larger platforms or custom systems can take several months.

f5.q: Can you redesign or improve existing platforms?
f5.a: Absolutely. We can modernize outdated systems, improve SEO, optimize performance, redesign interfaces, and scale existing applications.

f6.q: Do you provide ongoing support after launch?
f6.a: Yes. We offer maintenance, monitoring, feature updates, optimization, and technical support after deployment when needed.

pan-y-chocolate.title: Pan y Chocolate
pan-y-chocolate.description: Pan y Chocolate POS is a mobile Point of Sale application developed for cafeterias and restaurants, designed to simplify order processing, payment management, thermal receipt printing and sales reporting while improving operational efficiency.
pan-y-chocolate.what: What is Pan y Chocolate POS?
pan-y-chocolate.what-text1: The application digitizes the complete sales workflow, allowing employees to process customer orders quickly while maintaining an accurate record of every transaction.
pan-y-chocolate.what-text2: It was specifically created for cafeterias, restaurants and similar businesses where speed, reliability and organization are essential.
pan-y-chocolate.what-text3: Every completed sale is automatically stored, printed through a thermal printer and later grouped into business closures, providing detailed statistics for administrators.

f1.title: Product Management
f1.description: Create, edit and organize products and categories with full CRUD operations.

f2.title: Sales Processing
f2.description: Fast checkout process optimized for cafeterias and restaurants.

f3.title: Order Management
f3.description: Efficiently manage and track customer orders from start to finish.

f4.title: Payment Methods
f4.description: Support for cash and bank transfer payments during checkout.

f5.title: Thermal Printing
f5.description: Generate and print professional receipts using thermal printers.

f6.title: Ticket History
f6.description: Every completed sale is securely stored for future reference.

f7.title: Business Closures
f7.description: Group tickets into daily closures with sales statistics and totals.

f8.title: User Roles
f8.description: Separate permissions for administrators and cashiers.

f9.title: Import & Export
f9.description: Transfer products, categories and tickets between installations.

pan-y-chocolate.admin-description: Full system access including user management, products, categories, reports, imports, exports, sales history and business closures.
pan-y-chocolate.cashier-description: Focused on customer service by selecting products, processing sales and printing receipts without administrative permissions.
pan-y-chocolate.cta-title: Interested in a custom POS solution?
pan-y-chocolate.cta-description: Whether you need a restaurant POS, inventory system or a custom business application, QuarticCode can build it.
